nodes.label: lava-goo SVG metaball filter
nodes.rationale: Lives in the document shell (index.html) rather than in a React component because filter: url(#lava-goo) resolves against the document, and the controls that use it are spread across three routes and two lazily-loaded chunks. A component-local copy would create duplicate ids once two instances were on screen (the exact case this exists for); a copy mounted into document.body on first render would be a pre-paint side effect for nine lines of markup. Placed here it costs ~400 bytes, exists before anything can reference it, and there is only ever one instance. Internally: feGaussianBlur bleeds blobs together, feColorMatrix multiplies the alpha channel by 20 and subtracts 8 to turn the soft bleed back into a hard edge (the metaball effect), and feBlend re-composites the untouched source blobs on top so their cores keep the full accent colour instead of the threshold's approximation. color-interpolation-filters="sRGB" is required because the default linearRGB would run the threshold against gamma-decoded values, producing a colour visibly lighter than --brand on every skin.

nodes.label: theme-init.js pre-paint script tag
nodes.rationale: Palette/skin initialization is applied via an external script file rather than an inline <script> block so the CSP in vercel.json can refuse script-src 'unsafe-inline' outright.
